title: [Documentation] hierarchicalMenu `cssClasses.depth` option seems wrong
body: Probably a bad copy/paste. There's no "depth" element, but a class to differentiate the different depths of items in the hierarchy, right? Proposition: > CSS class to add to each item element to denote its depth. The actual level will be appended to the given class name (ie. if `"depth"` is given, the widget will add `"depth0"`, `"depth1"`, ... according to the level of each item).
